llm_response.reason: The website lacks real company/address information, uses only a form as contact method, and contains repetitive but vague security assurances. It offers branded products (Camper shoes) at implied discounts but is not listed as an official seller. SSL issues and incomplete contact/legal data are present. Multiple online search results and discussions label it as a scam, referencing lack of deliveries, fake shops, and user losses. These characteristics fit several known online scam patterns, confirming it is a fake online shopping site.
